title: Extremal Families for Matchings in Permutations
summary: Two permutations $σ,τ\in S_n$ are called disjoint if the composition $στ^{-1}$ has no fixed point. If a family $\mathcal F\subseteq S_n$ contains no $s$ pairwise disjoint permutations, then a simple averaging argument gives $|\mathcal F|\leq(s-1)(n-1)!$. Inozemtsev, Kolupaev and Kupavskii characterized the equality cases in the range $s\leq n/(2^{17}\log n).$ We characterize all equality cases throughout the range $2\le s\le n$: equality holds if and only if $\mathcal F$ is a union of $(s-1)$ pairwise disjoint $1$-cosets.
